import ast, collections, copy, datetime, gzip, hashlib, inspect, json, math, re, sys, types, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
PLAN_SHA = "dc1959b18e9c5fdaf5a61b2a3487d8ce3588c7fb5236ff06a1e78e3929cf1e7b"
HELPER_SHA = "547b7d9a9c4c37120f8dbb0fa0b8d0b8b768ff1613d8004869a863a89cd118c3"
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def load(path, name, expected):
    content = path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == expected, str(path)
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__ = str(path)
    exec(compile(content, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)
    return module
helper = load(DATA / "v54-verify.py", "v56_options_helper", HELPER_SHA)
require, read, flags, close = helper.require, helper.read, helper.flags, helper.close
def exact(a,b): return json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)==json.dumps(b,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)
FALLBACK_FIELDS=("ipm_numerical_fallback_attempts","ipm_numerical_fallback_successes")
ALLOWED_STATUSES={"optimal","infeasible","unbounded","infeasible_or_unbounded","empty","time_limit","iteration_limit",
    "solution_limit","objective_bound","objective_target","interrupted","memory_limit","unknown","error","numerical_error","verification_failed"}
def validate_status(report):
    require(type(report.get("status")) is str and report["status"] in ALLOWED_STATUSES,"未知状态不得冒充合法失败")

def fallback_contract(report,backend,version):
    if version==57:
        require(all(key not in report for key in FALLBACK_FIELDS),"旧v57不得伪造新计数")
        return
    require(version==58 and all(key in report for key in FALLBACK_FIELDS),"新v58两计数字段必须存在")
    if backend!="ipm":
        require(all(report[key] is None for key in FALLBACK_FIELDS),"非IPM新计数必须null")
        return
    a,s=(report[key] for key in FALLBACK_FIELDS)
    require(type(a) is int and type(s) is int and 0<=s<=a<=1,"数值尝试/成功严格整数且0<=s<=a<=1")
    actual=report["ipm_factor_backend"]
    structural=report["ipm_structural_fallbacks"]
    require(type(structural) is int and 0<=structural<=1,"结构回退计数严格整数")
    if a:
        require(structural==0 and actual in ("normal_cholmod","sparselu"),"数值与结构回退不得混用")
    if s:
        require(actual=="sparselu","重解成功必须已经启用LU")
    if actual=="sparselu":
        require(a==1 and structural==0 and type(report["ipm_factorizations"]) is int and report["ipm_factorizations"]>=2,
                "实际LU必须有数值尝试及原因子/新增LU分解工作证据")
    if actual=="factorhighs":
        require(structural==1 and a==s==0,"结构备用内核不能冒充数值升级")
    if actual is None:
        require(a==s==structural==0,"未启动因子不能记录任何回退")

def fallback_self_check():
    tests=0
    def check(report,backend,version,valid):
        nonlocal tests
        try: fallback_contract(report,backend,version)
        except (AssertionError,KeyError,TypeError,ValueError):
            require(not valid,"合法数值回退反例被拒")
        else: require(valid,"非法数值回退反例被接受")
        tests+=1
    check({},"ipm",57,True)
    check({FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:0,FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]:0},"ipm",57,False)
    check({key:None for key in FALLBACK_FIELDS},"highs",58,True)
    check({},"highs",58,False)
    check({key:0 for key in FALLBACK_FIELDS},"highs",58,False)
    template={FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:0,FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]:0,"ipm_factor_backend":"normal_cholmod",
              "ipm_structural_fallbacks":0,"ipm_factorizations":2}
    for actual,a,s,structural in (("normal_cholmod",0,0,0),("normal_cholmod",1,0,0),("sparselu",1,0,0),
                                  ("sparselu",1,1,0),("factorhighs",0,0,1),(None,0,0,0)):
        report={**template,"ipm_factor_backend":actual,FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:a,FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]:s,"ipm_structural_fallbacks":structural}
        check(report,"ipm",58,True)
    for changes in ({FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:True},{FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:-1},{FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:2},
        {FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]:True},{FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]:1},{FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]:0.0},
        {FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:1,"ipm_structural_fallbacks":1},
        {FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:1,FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]:1},
        {"ipm_factor_backend":"sparselu"},
        {FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:1,"ipm_factor_backend":None},
        {FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:1,"ipm_factor_backend":"sparselu","ipm_factorizations":1},
        {"ipm_structural_fallbacks":-1},
        {FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]:1,"ipm_factor_backend":"qdldl"},
        {"ipm_factor_backend":"factorhighs"}):
        check({**template,**changes},"ipm",58,False)
    missing=dict(template);missing.pop(FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]);check(missing,"ipm",58,False)
    validate_status({"status":"numerical_error"})
    for status in ("bogus",None,True,4):
        try: validate_status({"status":status})
        except AssertionError: pass
        else: raise AssertionError("未知状态污染未拒绝")
    return {"passed":True,"fallback_cases":tests,"status_cases":5,"solver_runs":0}
self_check=fallback_self_check()
if "--self-check" in sys.argv:
    print(json.dumps(self_check,ensure_ascii=False))
    sys.exit(0)

            options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod" &&
            (options.ipm.linear_accuracy == "strict" || options.ipm.linear_accuracy == "homogeneous_repair"))""" in new_text,

upgrade="""  void upgrade_to_sparse_lu(const SolveOptions& options, Clock::time_point start, SolveResult& result) {
    check_budget(options, start);
    // 保留当前已排列、消元和均衡的 Kδ，不重复装配或重启正则搜索。
    const std::vector<Index> starts(ap_.begin(), ap_.end());
    const std::vector<Index> rows(ai_.begin(), ai_.end());
    check_budget(options, start);
    auto candidate = std::make_unique<detail::SparseLu>(factor_dimension_, starts, rows);
    check_budget(options, start);
    const auto& values = equilibration_.empty() ? ax_ : factor_values_;
    ++*result.ipm_factorizations;
    const bool success = candidate->factor(values);
    check_budget(options, start);
    if (!success) throw NumericalFailure("当前 KKT 稀疏 LU 数值升级分解失败");
    sparse_lu_ = std::move(candidate);
    normal_cholesky_.reset();
    result.ipm_factor_backend = "sparselu";
    result.ipm_kkt_dimension = static_cast<Index>(factor_dimension_);
    result.ipm_factor_nonzeros = sparse_lu_->factor_nonzeros();
  }"""
require(new_text.count(upgrade)==1,"同Kdelta升级源码与实际分解/预算/真实后端顺序")

def objective_mode(stage,reference): return None if stage=="highs" and reference else "off"
def verify_options(report,frozen,backend,version,mode):
    validate_status(report)
    fallback_contract(report,backend,version)
    copied=copy.deepcopy(report)
    if backend=="ipm" and report["ipm_factor_backend"]=="sparselu":
        copied["ipm_factor_backend"]="normal_cholmod"
    if backend=="ipm":
        require(report["backend_version"]==("ipm-cpu-0.47.0" if version==57 else "ipm-cpu-0.48.0"),"真实本侧IPM版本")
        require(type(report["options"]["ipm"]["objective_scaling"]) is bool and report["options"]["ipm"]["objective_scaling"] is False,"实际off布尔")
        copied["backend_version"]="ipm-cpu-0.45.0"
    helper.verify_options(copied,frozen,backend,54,mode)
    if backend=="highs":
        require(report["backend_version"]=="1.15.1","实际HiGHS版本")

def audit_stage(stage):
    group=group_audit(stage,identities,plan,benchmark,compare)
    manifest,summary,rows=group
    require(exact(group,runner.archive(stage)),"冻结runner归档与独立核验一致")
    invalid=[]; missing=[]; failed=[]
    for row in rows:
        valid=helper.valid_process_report(row,benchmark.classify(row["returncode"],row["report"]))
        brief={key:row[key] for key in ("run_index","input","requested_variant","returncode","classification","quality_failure")}
        if not valid:
            invalid.append(brief)
            require(row["quality_pass"] is False and row["quality_penalized_wall_seconds"]==35 and row["quality_penalized_numerical_seconds"]==5,"无效进程必须完整罚分")
        if row["report"] is None: missing.append(brief)
        else:
            require(all(helper.finite(row["report"]["timings"].get(k)) and row["report"]["timings"][k]>=0 for k in ("read_seconds","solve_seconds","verification_seconds","total_seconds")),"所有报告四计时有限")
        if not row["quality_pass"]: failed.append(brief)
    current_reports=[row for row in rows if isinstance(row["report"],dict) and row["report"].get("backend_version")=="ipm-cpu-0.48.0"]
    attempts=[row for row in current_reports if row["report"][FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]]>0]
    fallback_summary={"reports":len(current_reports),"attempted_runs":len(attempts),
        "attempts":sum(row["report"][FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]] for row in current_reports),
        "successes":sum(row["report"][FALLBACK_FIELDS[1]] for row in current_reports),
        "actual_sparse_lu_runs":sum(row["report"]["ipm_factor_backend"]=="sparselu" for row in current_reports),
        "details":[{"input":row["input"],"run_index":row["run_index"],"status":row["report"]["status"],
                    "quality_pass":row["quality_pass"],"quality_failure":row["quality_failure"],
                    **{key:row["report"][key] for key in (*FALLBACK_FIELDS,"ipm_factor_backend","ipm_structural_fallbacks","ipm_factorizations")}}
                   for row in attempts]}
    stage_results[stage]={"runs":len(rows),"numerical_fallback":fallback_summary,"reference_variant":manifest["reference_variant"],"candidate_variant":manifest["candidate_variant"],
        "variants":summary["variants"],"both_variants_all_repeats_pass_count":summary["both_variants_all_repeats_pass_count"],
        "missing_reports":missing,"invalid_process_reports":invalid,"failed_runs":failed,
        "artifacts":{suffix:sha(DATA/("v58-"+stage+suffix)) for suffix in ("-manifest.json","-summary.json","-runs.jsonl.gz","-command.json","-process.json","-run.log")}}
    groups[stage]=group
audit_stage("development")

def differences(stage):
    manifest,_,rows=groups[stage]
    sides=(manifest["reference_variant"],manifest["candidate_variant"])
    counts={model["input"]:[0,0] for model in plan["sets"][stage]["models"]}
    for row in rows: counts[row["input"]][sides.index(row["requested_variant"])]+=int(row["quality_pass"])
    return ([Path(k).stem for k,v in counts.items() if v[1]<v[0]],
            [Path(k).stem for k,v in counts.items() if v[1]>v[0]])
def sgm(stage,side,kind):
    rows=[r for r in groups[stage][2] if r["requested_variant"]==side]
    return math.expm1(sum(math.log1p(r["quality_penalized_"+kind+"_seconds"]/10) for r in rows)/len(rows))*10

def report_diagnostic(stage):
    manifest,_,rows=groups[stage]
    sides=(manifest["reference_variant"],manifest["candidate_variant"])
    pairs=collections.defaultdict(dict)
    for row in rows:
        pairs[(row["input"],row["repetition"])][row["requested_variant"]]=row
    result={"pairs":len(pairs),"untriggered_pairs":0,"untriggered_equal":0,"untriggered_different":0,
            "triggered_pairs":0,"invalid_pairs":0,"pair_records":[],
            "excluded_fields":["timings","backend_version",*FALLBACK_FIELDS],
            "diff_key_scope":"比较所有剩余顶层字段；数组或对象任一内容不同即记该键，完整值仍在原始raw。"}
    for (model,repetition),pair in pairs.items():
        require(set(pair)==set(sides),"诊断只使用完整事前对子")
        a,b=(pair[side] for side in sides)
        item={"input":model,"repetition":repetition,"reference_run_index":a["run_index"],"candidate_run_index":b["run_index"]}
        if not all(helper.valid_process_report(row,benchmark.classify(row["returncode"],row["report"])) for row in (a,b)):
            result["invalid_pairs"]+=1;item["classification"]="invalid";result["pair_records"].append(item);continue
        reports=copy.deepcopy([a["report"],b["report"]])
        for report in reports:
            for key in result["excluded_fields"]: report.pop(key,None)
        differences=sorted(key for key in set(reports[0])|set(reports[1]) if
            (key in reports[0])!=(key in reports[1]) or not exact(reports[0].get(key),reports[1].get(key)))
        same=not differences and a["returncode"]==b["returncode"]
        triggered=b["report"][FALLBACK_FIELDS[0]]>0
        result["triggered_pairs" if triggered else "untriggered_pairs"]+=1
        if not triggered: result["untriggered_equal" if same else "untriggered_different"]+=1
        item.update(triggered=triggered,reports_equal=same,different_report_keys=differences,
                    exit_codes=[a["returncode"],b["returncode"]],
                    budget_limited=any(row["report"]["status"]=="time_limit" or row["numerical_seconds"]>5 or
                        row["elapsed_wall_seconds"]>35 for row in (a,b)))
        for label,row in (("reference",a),("candidate",b)):
            report=row["report"]
            item[label]={"status":report["status"],"quality_pass":row["quality_pass"],"quality_failure":row["quality_failure"],
                         "wall_seconds":row["elapsed_wall_seconds"],"numerical_seconds":row["numerical_seconds"],
                         "timings":report["timings"],**{key:report.get(key) for key in
                         ("ipm_iterations","ipm_refinement_steps","ipm_weighted_krylov_steps","ipm_factorizations",
                          "ipm_factor_backend",*FALLBACK_FIELDS)}}
        result["pair_records"].append(item)
    return result
